set.pl: Field on the Ford quarter, SW¼ sec. 29 T5N R21E, southern Town of Franklin (1876 atlas); house site at the SW corner of the quarter
pinev: 1876 atlas shows the Ford 160 as SW¼ sec. 29 T5N R21E with the house dot at its SW corner; the 600 m circle covers the whole quarter, the house site and part of the Ford 80 to the north.

tw-wi-franklin-ford-gold-1875.t: Ford family land ran about 280 acres (SW¼ and E½ NW¼ sec 29, SE¼ SE¼ sec 19); house site at the SW corner of the quarter.
src: Atlas of Milwaukee County (1876), Town of Franklin
